name: The Travelling Land
detailed_description:
Note: The game is in the prototyping stage. Please note that most of the content you see at this date doesn't reflect the final game and will be subject to many changes.

A Floating City with Endless Possibilities

Command Your Island

Build your city on a drifting island, carefully designing vertical structures to preserve precious space. Strategically plan every tile to maintain the delicate balance of your ecosystem.

Dynamic Terraforming & Water Management

Sculpt the landscape to create thriving biomes like lush grasslands, dense forests, marshy swamps, or arid deserts. Manage realistic water physics: pump seawater, desalinate it, carve rivers, control floods, and irrigate strategically to nurture biodiversity.

Eco-Focused Gameplay

Rescue and shelter diverse animal species displaced by extreme climates. Offer them suitable habitats and carefully balance their unique needs, enriching your island’s ecological harmony.

Wind-Driven Navigation

Sail strategically by harnessing dynamic weather systems and realistic wind patterns. Tack into favorable winds, plan routes carefully, and respond swiftly to unpredictable storms.

Resource Management & Sustainability

Balance essential resources: food, water, energy in an ever-changing environment. Embrace recycling, renewable energy, and sustainability to keep your ecosystem healthy and your city thriving.

Immersive Exploration

Explore distant shores to uncover rare resources, secrets, and stranded communities. Each expedition shapes your island’s fate—strengthening it or challenging its delicate equilibrium.

Adapt, Evolve, Prosper

Unlock technologies, construct specialized buildings, and evolve your floating island from a humble refuge to a flourishing, eco-friendly haven in a world forever changed by climate extremes.

short_description: Build, sail, and thrive in a strategic floating city! Manage biomes, rescue species, and harness the power of wind to navigate a world shaped by extreme climates. Balance ecology, exploration, and survival in this unique city-builder.
supported_languages:
English*, French*, Spanish - Spain
*languages with full audio support

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit versions)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-6600K / AMD Ryzen 5 1400 or equivalent
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GeForce GTX 950, Radeon R9 380 or similar
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit versions)
  • Processor: Intel Core i7-4790 / AMD Ryzen 5 1500X or better
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GeForce RTX 2070, Radeon RX 5700 or similar
